description:
Parent infrastructure for ParserNG mathematical runtime.
        Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies. 
        Version 3.0.1 features GPU bulk evaluation and the highly stable SIMDEngineEvaluator which combines CPU pinning of threads with its workers. It also sports
        a SIMDCommandTurboEvaluator class which is a bit slower than
        ensuring hardware acceleration of all user designed functions and inbuilt functions that can be expressed in terms of the Vector API
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034
